title: Alphabet Bets Big on 100 Years of Debt
title_zh: Alphabet 在 100 年的债务上下了重注
summary: Alphabet is breaking new ground with plans to sell a rare 100 year bond - the first ultra long debt sale by a technology firm since Motorola in 1997.
summary_zh: Alphabet 正在开辟新领域，计划发行罕见的 100 年期债券，这是自 1997 年摩托罗拉以来科技公司首次发行超长期债券。

title: Memory Chip Crunch Ripples Through Markets, With Worse to Come
title_zh: 内存芯片紧缩波及市场，更糟糕的情况即将到来
summary: Companies from game console maker Nintendo Co. to big PC brands and Apple Inc. suppliers are seeing shares slump on profitability concerns. Memory producers, meanwhile, are soaring to unprecedented heights.
summary_zh: 由于对盈利能力的担忧，从游戏机制造商任天堂公司到大型个人电脑品牌和苹果公司供应商的股价都在下跌。与此同时，内存生产商正在飙升至前所未有的高度。

title: Asia stocks rise as Nikkei sets fresh record, dollar drops
title_zh: 日经指数创下新高，亚洲股市上涨，美元下跌
summary: By Gregor Stuart Hunter SINGAPORE, Feb 10 (Reuters) - Asian stocks advanced for a second day in early trading on Tuesday, led by an extended rally in Tokyo's benchmark after Japanese Prime Minister
summary_zh: 路透新加坡 2 月 10 日 - 周二早盘交易中，亚洲股市连续第二天上涨，日本首相发表讲话后，东京基准指数延续上涨势头。

title: Amazon plans to launch AI content marketplace, The Information reports
title_zh: 据 The Information 报道，亚马逊计划推出人工智能内容市场
summary: Amazon has signaled to publishing industry executives that it is planning ​to launch a marketplace where publishers ‌can sell their content to firms offering artificial intelligence products, ‌The Information reported on Monday.
summary_zh: 据《The Information》周一报道，亚马逊已向出版业高管发出信号，计划推出一个市场，出版商可以将其内容出售给提供人工智能产品的公司。

title: US plans Big Tech carve-out from next chip tariffs, FT reports
title_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，美国计划将大型科技公司排除在下一次芯片关税之外

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures steady with Wall Street near records ahead of jobs, CPI data
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货持稳，华尔街在就业数据、消费者物价指数 (CPI) 数据之前接近历史纪录
summary: Wall Street is eyeing a closely watched jobs report amid a cooling labour market.
summary_zh: 在劳动力市场降温之际，华尔街正在密切关注一份备受关注的就业报告。

title: Alphabet's debt raise fuels forecasts for record year in corporate bond sales
title_zh: Alphabet 的债务增加推动了公司债券销售创纪录的一年
summary: Google parent Alphabet tapped the U.S. high-grade bond market on Monday, adding to a boom in debt funding by AI companies that analysts project will lead ​to a record-breaking year for corporate debt issuance.
summary_zh: 谷歌母公司 Alphabet 周一登陆美国高等级债券市场，加剧了人工智能公司债务融资的热潮，分析师预计这将导致企业债务发行创纪录的一年。

title: OpenAI's new bull case: Why Google hasn't won quite yet
title_zh: OpenAI 的新牛市：为什么谷歌还没有获胜
summary: DA Davidson is getting bullish on OpenAI (OPAI.PVT).
summary_zh: DA Davidson 越来越看好 OpenAI (OPAI.PVT)。

title: Alphabet Embarks on Global Bond Spree to Fund Record Spending
title_zh: Alphabet 发起全球债券热潮，为创纪录的支出提供资金
summary: The Google parent raised $20 billion in its biggest ever US dollar bond sale on Monday — more than the $15 billion initially expected, after racking up one of the biggest order books of all time.
summary_zh: 周一，这家谷歌母公司在其有史以来最大的美元债券发行中筹集了 200 亿美元，超过最初预期的 150 亿美元，此前该债券创下了有史以来最大的订单之一。
